name: Takethy Photo (verified vocabulary)
description: Personally verified prompt parts plus a shot-catalog supplement: camera (shot size / height / direction), numeric frame occupancy, gaze, expressions, body-part poses, capture devices, light. Base collected and tested on a local Qwen-Image 2.1 stack, 2026-11-22/23. Supplement 2026-11-28: camera-shot catalog (42 shot types + 6 keyword poses, circulating as the 'Camera Shot Collection' charts) merged in and deduplicated against the existing chips; supplement chips are catalog vocabulary, not yet individually verified.

Range: full body shot, head to toe visible
cowboy shot, framed from the knees up
medium shot, framed from the waist up
bust shot, framed from the chest up
extreme close-up, eye close-up, fine detail
Frame occupancy: the subject occupies about 20 percent of the frame height
the subject occupies about 40 percent of the frame height
the subject occupies about 60 percent of the frame height
the subject occupies about 80 percent of the frame height
the subject fills the frame from the top edge to the bottom edge

Height / tilt: aerial oblique shot, high-angle diagonal view
Direction: foot-end view, seen from the feet end
looking slightly away from the camera
gaze fixed on the object in her hands
Note: natural candid gaze, not posing for the camera

Standing: weight shifted onto her left leg, right knee relaxed, one hand resting on her waist
reaching her left hand up toward a high shelf, chin lifted, gaze on the object above
one hand touching her hair, chin slightly down, looking up
arms loosely crossed, weight on one leg
hands clasped behind her back, leaning slightly forward
holding the hem of her skirt with both hands
Moving / sitting: walking toward the camera mid-stride, arms swinging naturally, gaze ahead
sitting on a bench, leaning back on one hand, legs crossed at the ankles
sitting with knees together, hands resting on her lap
Keyword poses: prone pose, lying on her stomach, chin on hands
kneeling, looking back over her shoulder
side-lying pose, head resting on one hand
cat pose, on all fours, back arched
back reveal, looking back over her shoulder
leaning against a wall, one knee bent

Devices: shot on a compact digital camera with direct flash
shot on a 2000s feature phone camera

Light: dust motes dancing in a shaft of sunlight

Effects: bokeh, shallow depth of field, blurred background

Viewpoints: mirror shot, reflection in a mirror
from inside an object, through a container

Patterns: negative space, ample empty space, minimal
